**Indikator 9** is a quality indicator in the Danish psychiatric healthcare system that measures the proportion of treatment courses among adults with an ADHD diagnosis where psychotherapy is assessed as relevant and actually received within one year of treatment initiation [^src1]. It was officially put into operation on April 1, 2024 [^src2]. The indicator is managed and reported by the [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-DATABASEN]] as part of its annual national quality report [^src1].

The primary significance of Indikator 9 is its exposure of a severe systemic shortfall in the provision of psychotherapy for adults with ADHD. For the reporting period of April 1, 2024, to March 31, 2025, the national fulfillment rate was just 1% (95% CI: 1–2) [^src1]. Out of 786 patients nationally who had a one-year follow-up and for whom psychotherapy was deemed relevant, the indicator was fulfilled for only 10 patients [^src2]. This stands in stark contrast to the indicator's development goal of ≥ 90% fulfillment [^src2]. The extremely low compliance highlights structural barriers, such as the limited capacity of the standard 9-hour ADHD package course to incorporate psychotherapy [^src2].

As a newly introduced metric, Indikator 9 is reported for the first time without historical data or trend graphs [^src2]. It specifically applies to adults (18+ years) within the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] [^src2]. While national compliance is low, there is some regional and departmental variation. Among regions with a minimum of three patients, fulfillment ranges from 0% in [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] to 4% in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] [^src2]. In [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], fewer than three patients in total were assessed as needing psychotherapy [^src2]. At the departmental level, most units scored 0%, but the [[pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik|PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik]] in the Capital Region achieved a 9% fulfillment rate [^src2].

In light of these results, the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] has engaged in strategic discussions regarding the prioritization of quality indicators. The committee noted that focus should primarily be directed toward improving the fulfillment rate of Indikator 8 before seriously pushing the implementation and compliance of Indikator 9 [^src2].

## Claims
- Indikator 9 opnåede 1 % (95 % CI: 1–2) i perioden 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 og rapporteres første gang uden historik [^src1] (indikator-9)
  Type: performance | Page: 6
- Indikator 9 vedrører voksne (18+ år) og er første gang opgjort uden historik og trendgraf [^src1] (indikator-9, adhd-behandlingspopulation)

- På landsplan har der været 786 patienter med et års opfølgning for hvem psykoterapi var relevant, og blandt disse er indikatoren kun opfyldt for 10 patienter (1 %) [^src1] (indikator-9, adhd-behandlingspopulation)
  Type: performance | Page: 46
- Udviklingsmålet for indikator 9 er ≥ 90 % [^src1] (indikator-9)
  Type: policy | Page: 46
- Blandt regioner med minimum tre patienter varierer resultaterne fra 0 % i Sjælland og Nordjylland til 4 % i Hovedstaden [^src1] (indikator-9, region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-nordjylland)
  Type: regional-variation | Page: 46
- I Syddanmark var psykoterapi vurderet relevant hos mindre end tre patienter i alt [^src1] (indikator-9, region-syddanmark)
  Type: regional-variation | Page: 46
- Blandt afdelinger med minimum tre patienter i nævneren varierer resultaterne fra 0 % (på de fleste afdelinger) til 9 % (PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik i Hovedstaden) [^src1] (indikator-9, pck-psykoterapeutisk-klinik, region-hovedstaden)
  Type: performance | Page: 46
